findings.claim: Live/resumed delivery does not reject or resnapshot on source-epoch changes, so a mutation from a different source epoch can be delivered under a checkpoint bound to the configured epoch.
findings.evidence: In `delivery_frame`, the checkpoint scope uses `source_epoch: &producer.source_epoch`, but the only delivery scope checks are `delivery.mutation.tenant_id != producer.request.tenant_id || !producer.request.entity_type.matches(&delivery.mutation)` before returning `EntityTypeWatchFrame::Mutation`; there is no check of `delivery.mutation.source.epoch` against `producer.source_epoch`. The snapshot path separately treats epoch mismatch as `ResnapshotReason::SourceEpochChanged` in `crates/frf-app/src/entity_type_watch.rs`, showing epoch changes are meant to fail explicitly rather than be delivered.
findings.suggested_fix: Before issuing/delivering a live mutation, compare `delivery.mutation.source.epoch` with `producer.source_epoch` and emit a terminal `ResnapshotRequired { reason: SourceEpochChanged, ... }` or equivalent fail-closed terminal instead of `Mutation`/`CheckpointAdvanced`.
